records.text: Silver Works is a week in with no project yet, worth a nudge at this point

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days since signup with zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone. No reply to the welcome email [email:ddffd07e], no tickets, no other inbound signal of intent. Pro plan suggests some commitment, but silence plus 8 days left makes unaided self-start unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Checking in after my note last week. Most teams get their footing by setting up a first project -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Chidi
